strategies.name: Sequential 8-stage all-reduce reference
strategies.desc: Performs 8 sequential all-reduce operations with element-wise scaling/unscaling between each stage, exactly as shown in the seed implementation. Dispatch count is 8 (one per all-reduce). This is the baseline: straightforward correctness with no optimization, trading simplicity for maximum collective overhead.

strategies.name: Fused local-ops interleaved all-reduce
strategies.desc: Merges all element-wise scaling operations (multiply by a[r]/W and divide by a[r]) into single vectorized kernels between all-reduces, eliminating separate clone() operations. Dispatch count remains 8 all-reduces but reduces local kernel launches from ~16 to ~8 by fusing scale+unscale within each iteration. Trades kernel fusion complexity for reduced dispatch overhead on local operations.

strategies.name: Pipelined ring-based reduce-scatter + all-gather
strategies.desc: Decomposes each all-reduce into reduce-scatter followed by all-gather, allowing pipeline overlap of computation and communication across the 8 stages. Dispatch count increases to 16 collective operations but enables hiding local scaling work during data movement. Trades increased collective count for better latency hiding through pipelining.

strategies.name: Hierarchical two-level aggregation per stage
strategies.desc: Exploits multi-node structure by performing intra-node all-reduce followed by inter-node all-reduce for each of the 8 stages, with local ops fused within node groups. Dispatch count is 16 (2 levels × 8 stages) but leverages faster intra-node bandwidth for bulk of data movement. Trades collective count for bandwidth-optimal routing on hierarchical topology.

strategies.name: Batched multi-stage tensor concatenation
strategies.desc:
Packs all 8 intermediate buffers into a single larger tensor (224×256×8 elements), performs a single all-reduce on the packed tensor, then locally extracts and applies the 8-stage unscaling transformations. Dispatch count reduced to 1 all-reduce but with 8× payload size and complex local unpacking logic. Trades memory footprint and single-large-message latency for minimal collective dispatch overhead.
